title: PGC Reference Implementation: Protocol Compiler (protocol_compiler)
description:
Topology-native governance compiler. Translates protocol declarations into sealed, verified projections and decides admissibility: an artifact violating the constitutional surface is refused rather than repaired downstream. Contains no runtime logic.

Part of the Protocol-Governed Computing reference corpus. Cite the version DOI of the release you used, not the concept DOI.
notes: Implements or supports the Open PGC Standard (10.5281/zenodo.22150616). Version is taken from the GitHub release tag; do not hard-code it here.
